datasets.name: PlanetScope and RapidEye remote sensing images
datasets.verbatim: Multi-temporal HR remote sensing images from Planet Labs86 were downloaded which comprised of four bands: Blue, Green, Red, and Near-Infrared or NIR. ... The spatial resolution of the PlanetScope and RapidEye images were 3-m and 5-m, respectively.

datasets.name: Co-seismic landslide inventories (Gorkha, Wenchuan, Porgera, Kaikōura)
datasets.verbatim: For all the cases under consideration, the co-seismic landslide inventories are already available in the literature for the entire areas affected by landslides. ... Table 6. Accessible datasets through the literature on the MT-inventory sources and triggering mechanism.

datasets.name: Manually mapped landslide polygons (subset areas)
datasets.verbatim: Therefore, to fill those gaps in the gathered collection of MT inventories and also to address some minor edits/re-digitization in the existing inventories to cater for efficient training of the model, we manually mapped landslides for a subset of examined area in each case.

methods.name: Attention Deep Supervision Multi-Scale U-Net (ADSMS U-Net)
methods.summary: A deep learning semantic segmentation model based on U-Net architecture, enhanced with multi-scale inputs and soft attention gates. It uses Focal Tversky Loss for training and is designed for transfer learning to map landslides across different regions and temporal windows.
methods.verbatim: In this study, we propose a novel automated deep transfer learning strategy that enables the mapping of landslides both over space and time. ... The link to the GitHub repository: https:// github. com/ kusha navbh uyan/ Large-scale- multi- spati otemp oral- lands lide- mappi ng.
